$comment: Where yonto.fetch sends a server's credential for a linkLogin plugin, and what it hands back, on both hosts. Each case links the source with `account`, lets the host read `hostAnswers` (the account's server list, and a server's identity at a typed address), then fetches `url` with `headers`. `sent` is each hop the plugin's request made, with the value of the service's server header (its name from the manifest's service, in contracts/link-logins.json or declarations.json), Range and If-Range it carried; `answer` is what the plugin was handed, and `refused` the code and words it was refused with. test/link-login.test.js walks it through the CLI's yonto.fetch and PluginSessionAttachRecordTest through the device's.

cases.why: a server's credential goes on the hop to a host it is bound to, over any spelling of its header the plugin set, and Range and If-Range go from that hop
a host no server is bound to gets nothing from the host, and keeps the plugin's own header and range
a redirect off the bound host carries nothing to the next
and one back onto it carries it again
a redirect off an origin drops the plugin's own spelling of the service's credential headers, as it drops authorization and cookie, from an unbound host to an unbound one
and from one bound host to another across origins, each hop carries its own server's credential over the plugin's header
and from an unbound host to a bound one, the plugin's header goes on the first hop and the server's credential on the second
the bound host over http is another place
and so is another port on it
an owned server is bound to nothing
the address the viewer typed carries its server's credential once the server there says it is that server
and nothing when another server answers there
or when nothing says who it is
with no session nothing is bound
every held credential is masked in everything the plugin is handed, in each spelling
a URL carrying a held credential is refused before anything is sent

refused.message: the URL carries a credential the host holds, and one never goes in a URL

cases.why: a server's refusal the host puts in words is masked too

refused.message: https://203-0-113-7.aaaa.plex.direct:32400/go redirected to something that is not a URL: gopher://x/?t=yonto-held-credential

cases.why: a redirect whose target carries a held credential is refused before it is followed, wherever it points

refused.message: https://203-0-113-7.aaaa.plex.direct:32400/go redirected to a URL carrying a credential the host holds

cases.why: a later hop's redirect carrying a held credential is refused too, after a first hop between bound hosts is followed

refused.message: https://192-168-1-5.aaaa.plex.direct:32400/next redirected to a URL carrying a credential the host holds

cases.why: a server header's template carries the credential, over any spelling of that header the plugin set, and the credential is masked out of it wherever an answer echoes it
